j4q.shaders

Class TextureNormalMapPhongShader

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.Component
      • j4q.shaders.Shader
        • j4q.shaders.TextureNormalMapPhongShader

  • public class TextureNormalMapPhongShader
extends Shader
    Shader for rendering objects with textured normal mapping and Phong lighting.

    Supports ambient, diffuse, and specular color configuration, exponent control, texture and normal map binding.
